title: Chicken wing, baked or broiled, from pre‑cooked

content.title: About
content.content: Chicken wings are small pieces of poultry meat that are typically baked or broiled. In this case they are pre‑cooked (pre‑boiled, seasoned and cooled), allowing quick reheating in the oven or on a grill without further cooking.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Wings are a staple in American cuisine, especially for "Buffalo wings".
Pre‑cooked wings can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 5 days or frozen for up to 3 months.
Baking without added oil retains most of the flavor while keeping the dish lower in fat.
Wings are rich in collagen, which may support joint and skin health.
Various sauces—from sweet‑spicy to creamy—are paired with wings around the world.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Chicken wings provide high‑quality protein essential for muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: They contain vitamin B6 and niacin, which support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Contains minerals
items.content: Wings supply iron, zinc, and phosphorus important for blood health and bones.

items.title: Low in carbohydrates
items.content: Makes them suitable for low‑carb dietary patterns.

items.title: Promotes satiety
items.content: The combination of protein and moderate fat helps keep you feeling full longer.

items.title: Chicken allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to chicken proteins.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Pre‑cooked wings are often salted; people monitoring sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: Risk of over‑consumption
items.content: Flavorful sauces and seasonings can lead to eating more than the recommended portion.

items.title: Proper reheating
items.content: When reheating, ensure the internal temperature reaches at least 74 °C to prevent foodborne illness.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Reheat the wings in a 180 °C oven for 10‑15 minutes or quickly broil them on a grill. Serve with your favorite sauces, vegetable sticks, or a salad. Adding extra spices before reheating can boost flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. For longer storage, freeze in a zip‑lock bag at –18 °C, where they retain quality for up to 3 months. Always reheat thoroughly before eating.
